segments.en: Peace and blessing and all good forever — to the honored self of our dear beloved friend — from among the dear and beloved fellowship who long for the service of Hashem truly — and for drawing close to the true Tzadik truly — and especially to Na Nach Nachma Nachman MayUman — for that is the essential ultimate purpose of all ultimate purposes — and the essential success of the soul truly — the distinguished Torah scholar, our Master R' Arye Weinstock, may he live and be strong.
